description:
Small polish items from the review:

- `terminal.ex:46`: `unless skip_raw_mode, do: raw_mode_fn.(:enter)`
  → flip to pattern-matched heads or `if not` form; keep
  consistent with the rest of the codebase.
- `interactive.ex` `shutdown/3` uses imperative
  `for pid <- [...] do ... end`; replace with `Enum.each/2`
  or explicit sequencing.
- `Terminal.state/1` is a debug API with a confusing name;
  rename to `info/1` and mark `@doc false` if tests are its
  only user.
- `Components.Input.focused` field is now vestigial (cursor is
  painted by the terminal post-cursor-fix). Either remove it
  entirely or repurpose it as "skip key dispatch when false"
  (which is already what the unfocused clause does — it just
  doesn't do anything visible). Remove for simplicity.

No tests required; existing suites verify the behavior.
title: Style polish grab-bag (unless / for / state / :focused)
